main_text.p:
Chara tu vnic è mihi,
Tu mea ô columbula,
Tu mea integ rrima.
3. Ast ego,eheu,restitās
Nuda quinā,inquā iacens,
Vestem ego refumpferim:
Et pedes quos ablui,
Inquinarim denuo!
4. Interim manum sera
Amouentem sentiens
Vnicè charum mihi:
Corde toto palpitans,
Surgo,prendo myrrhæis
Totum odoribus manu
Delibutam pessulum.
5. Pando ianuæ fores
Vnicè charo mihi,
Illesed discesserat,
Iile iam transiuerat,
Vnicè charus mihi:
Cuius ante vocula
Intimis vitam mihi
Ex medullis sux: rat.
Ergo vt amens cursito,
Quæritánsque clamito:
Ille pâret nuspiam,
Nec vocantem exaudiit.
6. Ciuitatis obuia
Fasta sic custodibus,
Cædor imò vulneror,
Quin peplū ipsūmet mihi

Forte si videbitis,
Id reperto dicite,
Ipsius languere me
Casto amore sauciam.
Hierofolymitanæ.
8 At cedo,hē tu virginū
Omnium pulcherrima,
main_text.head: SPONSA.

page.notes: Right column begins at "Forte si videbitis" and is set beside the left column. The bottom of the left column is cut off at the foot of this part; the text there continues beyond the visible scan. The left part of the scan is blank; the page's left-hand text is absent from this image. Several lines near the left edge of the verse column are partly cut off, so some letters are uncertain; "pupillu is" and "Laéteo" may be misread.
